```php
<?php

namespace App\Livewire;

use Livewire\Component;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;

class CreateLinkComponent extends Component
{
    // Public properties
    public $url = '';
    public $shortenedUrl = '';
    public $status = '';

    // Method to save the link
    public function store()
    {
        try {
            // Send a POST request to your backend endpoint to shorten the URL
            $response = Http::post('api/shorten-url', ['url' => $this->url]);

            if ($response->successful()) {
                $data = json_decode($response->body(), true);
                $this->status = 'success';
                $this->shortenedUrl = $data['shortened_url'];
            } else {
                $this->status = 'error';
                $this->shortenedUrl = '';
            }
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            $this->status = 'error';
            $this->shortenedUrl = '';
        }

        // Refresh the component to update the status and shortened URL
        $this->render();
    }

    // Method to delete the link (not implemented in this example)
    public function delete()
    {
        // Implement deletion logic here
    }
}
```
